set_text.text: 02 / UNDER THE SURFACE
Behind the Hatch
Engineering Precision · What Happens Below the Waterline

Once your order dives into production, our technical engine takes over. You do not have to worry about squeegee angles or mesh counts, but here is a look at the detail and engineering applied to every single run behind the scenes.
Vector Separations & Underbases: Artwork is broken into component layers. We calculate specific ink opacities, halftones, and baseline underbases to ensure crisp colors on dark fleece.
Press Calibration & Chemistry: Inks are custom-compounded to match exact Pantone targets, with viscosity adjusted for specific fabric weights and loopback weaves.
Thermal Curing Validation: Garments pass through forced-air conveyor dryers to permanently cure plastisol or water-based inks at exact thermal thresholds for high-impact durability.

03 / PRODUCTION TIMELINE
Turnaround & Scheduling
10 to 14 Business Days · Guaranteed Milestones
Quality manufacturing takes time. We do not cut corners, and we do not blow past realistic production windows.
Standard Turnaround: 10 to 14 business days from final art approval, deposit confirmation, and inventory delivery.
Days 1-3: Digital proofs, vector adjustments, and wholesale fabric allocation.
Days 4-5: Screen setup, ink chemistry compounding, and test strikes.
Days 6-10: High-volume press runs, quality-assurance audits, and post-cure inspection.
Days 11-12: Final counting, sorting, industrial packing, and shipping dispatch.

04 / TECHNICAL ART SPECS
Art Preparation Guidelines
Full In-House Handling · Pro-Grade Guidelines

A Note on Artwork: We handle art setup, separations, and layout execution in-house. Nate is a seasoned technician who has seen the cleanest vector files and the messiest low-res JPEGs imaginable. Rough or complex artwork might add a bit of prep time, but we know how to translate any visual style onto fabric. Just send the clearest files you have, and we take care of the rest.
If you are a professional design team providing press-ready artwork directly, please build to these machinery specifications:
Vector Files: Adobe Illustrator (.AI), vector-embedded PDFs, or .EPS files. All text must be permanently converted to outlines.
Raster Files: High-resolution .PSD or .TIFF assets scaled to 100% of final print size, outputting at 300 DPI minimum.
Color Matching: Specify solid Pantone (PMS) Solid Coated color numbers. Digital RGB/CMYK files will be converted to closest matching ink formulations automatically.
Minimum Linework: Positive lines must be a minimum of 1pt thick; negative spaces or knockouts must be at least 1.5pt thick to prevent ink bleeding or bridging during high-volume screen runs.
